title: Servepath Northstar: consolidated p50/p95/p99 latency panels by model, route and IO-mode
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a single, browsable dashboard (Servepath Northstar) that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency across model and route dimensions with an explicit split between streaming and non-streaming IO-mode. This ticket covers: 1) tracing hook additions to tag spans with model_id, route_id, and io_mode; 2) a metrics pipeline update to publish aggregated latency histograms and percentiles keyed by (model, route, io_mode); 3) dashboard panels and comparison views for engineers and SREs to quickly identify regressions and capacity pressure. The goal is to reduce time-to-root-cause for latency incidents and make regression detection actionable via alerts and drilldowns.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing: server and worker spans include attributes 'model_id', 'route_id', and 'io_mode' (streaming|nonstreaming)
Metrics: histogram metric 'redwood.servepath_latency_ms' emitted with labels model, route, io_mode and exported to metrics backend (Prometheus/Tempo-compatible histogram export)
Dashboards: Grafana dashboard 'Servepath Northstar' with: grouped heatmap, p50/p95/p99 panels, streaming vs non-streaming toggle, and a cohort selector for model version and route path
Alerts: baseline p95 SLO alert rule created for affected model-route pairs with templated severity and runbook link
Observability tests: end-to-end test in staging that generates synthetic shapes and validates histogram buckets and percentiles are populated
work_notes: 2025-02-10: Kickoff - scoped feature with PM and SRE. Decided to use a single histogram metric with labels to avoid combinatorial explosion of timeseries.

2025-02-12: Instrumentation PR opened - github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/8473. Added span tags and a server middleware to emit attributes for model and route. Integration tests added for io_mode tagging.

2025-02-14: Telemetry pipeline change - github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/8520 updates histogram aggregation and mapping to Prometheus summary/percentile exporter. Working with infra to verify cardinality controls.

2025-02-16: Design review - created dashboard mockups in Figma (Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Servepath+Northstar+mockups). Feedback: add streaming timeline overlay and trace-links for p99 spikes.

2025-02-18: Dashboard implementation PR - github.com/redwood-inference/grafana-dashboards/pull/8602. Panels created: 'Servepath heatmap by model/route', 'Percentiles by IO-mode', and 'Latency cohort explorer'.
2025-02-20: SRE review - added templated alert rule and runbook pointer. PR for alerting rules: github.com/redwood-inference/alerting/pull/8615.
2025-02-21: Performance note - observed extra cardinality on ephemeral test models; added sampling rule and label normalization step in metrics pipeline (PR 8520 comment thread).

2025-02-22: Partial rollout to staging. Synthetic traffic generator ran 12h smoke test. p50/p95 panels populated; a few io_mode label gaps discovered and traced to older service that doesn't set io_mode header (ticket created ENG-312865 to patch legacy library).
implementation_steps: Add span attributes in serving runtime: model_id, route_id, io_mode (instrumentation PR 8473)
Expose histogram metric redwood.servepath_latency_ms with labels (model, route, io_mode)
Update metrics pipeline to bucket histograms and export percentile calculations, add label normalization and cardinality cap
Create Grafana dashboard with templated variables (model, route, deployment, io_mode) and panels for p50/p95/p99
Wire trace links from p99 cells to tracing UI (Tempo/Jaeger) using trace_id fields emitted on logs
Add SLO/p95 alerting rule generator per model-route with sensible defaults and manual overrides
Run staging e2e with synthetic shapes and validate metrics and dashboards
Roll out to production behind feature flag and monitor telemetry for cardinality/ingestion cost
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: metric cardinality explosion if unnormalized route/model labels are used. Mitigation: add normalization step and whitelist of high-cardinality routes. Use sampling for low-value models.
Risk: older services not emitting io_mode causing gaps. Mitigation: default to 'nonstreaming' and schedule compatibility patch (ENG-312865).
Risk: increased metrics ingestion costs. Mitigation: histograms aggregated at edge and bucketed server-side; enable rollup retention policy for long-term storage.
Risk: dashboards mislead if synthetic workloads differ from production shapes. Mitigation: include cohort selectors and annotate panels with traffic shape metadata.
